MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 7

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 17

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 11

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

7. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 65

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

12. Solve for x: x + 7 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 4

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

14. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 12

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 13

17. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

18. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

20. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

22. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

23. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

24. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 3
